worldcombat.skill.teleport.summary: Fold space to blink to a manually chosen 3D spot and shake the foes locked onto you; a wild user jumps farther and releases its own target. A spot the whole body cannot stand in fails outright, and nothing is left behind.
worldcombat.skill.teleport.use.0: Open distance the instant you are pinned
worldcombat.skill.teleport.use.1: Shake the pursuers locked onto you
worldcombat.skill.teleport.use.2: Reach a cliff top or platform to safety
worldcombat.skill.teleport.description.0: Blink up to %1$s blocks to the chosen 3D spot — ground or a raised platform. It cannot be where you already stand, and a spot the whole body cannot fit in (such as inside a wall) fails outright. It leaves nothing behind.
worldcombat.skill.teleport.description.1: The moment you blink away, foes within %1$s blocks of where you stood that were locked onto you lose their target.
worldcombat.skill.teleport.far.on: Far blink: distance ×1.35 and shed radius ×1.2, at the cost of wind-up +3 and cooldown +26.
worldcombat.skill.teleport.far.off: Flash step: distance ×0.85, shed radius ×0.9 — cheaper wind-up and cooldown, good for repeated short hops.
worldcombat.skill.teleport.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.teleport.growth.0: From level %1$s the blink reaches %2$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.teleport.growth.1: From level %1$s the blink reaches %2$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.teleport.preference.fa: On: blink ×1.35, shed radius ×1.2, wind-up +3, cooldown +26. Off (flash step): distance ×0.85, shed radius ×0.9, cheaper wind-up and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.teleport.preference.ai: Below this health ratio the blink is ranked as the top escape; raise it to leave earlier, lower it to keep it for emergencies.
Only blinks to reposition when a threat is this close; lower it to blink only at point-blank, raise it to break away sooner.
When on, the user blinks away from its post even under a hold order.
worldcombat.skill.teleport.description.2: A wild user rides the momentum of escape to blink farther, and releases its own target on arrival.
worldcombat.skill.teleport.description.3: The landing is a free 3D point, including raised platforms; pursuit is shed only after a real, successful move, so a failed blink neither clears aggro nor moves you.
